content.question: How does t-SNE build its low-dimensional embedding?
options: By projecting the data onto the eigenvectors of the covariance matrix.
By averaging the values of the k closest points for each new data point.
By calculating similarities via a t-distribution and minimizing the divergence between the distributions of pairwise similarities in the low-dimensional space.
By fitting a multivariate normal distribution to each class.
content.answer: By calculating similarities via a t-distribution and minimizing the divergence between the distributions of pairwise similarities in the low-dimensional space.
